candidate.binding: Before collection freeze actual complete candidate source, emitted HTML, this contract, fixture helper, collector and generated resource hashes. Recheck all bytes after collection; reject changes. No candidate hash is inferred from a premeasurement file.

runtime.collectionIdentity: Record actual launched browser version, executable/module/package hashes, runtime versions, OS, CPU and collector argv. A directory version label is not a browser version observation.

matrix.enumeration: Exact registered cases from compactEnumerate; fixture roles are explicit subsets, not products of historical choice/variant/member counts. Both roots must resolve identical canonical case IDs. RTL is the same selected case with he/ar-AE display, never a fabricated protocol case. Primary latency: three fixtures x two views x three loaders x eight locales = 144. Full uses desktop1440; Compact uses phone390. Initial index closed; opening is an action. Separate 18 baseline-en/candidate-en cells and 126 candidate-en/native cells; English controls are not multiplied as eight baseline comparisons. Core/MCP remain field/resource probes.
comparisons: baseline-en versus candidate-en, same fixture/view/loader/viewport/index state and operation
candidate-en versus candidate-selected-locale, same fixture/view/loader/viewport/index state and operation
matrix.baselineFeaturePolicy: Frozen baseline has no locale control. Language-switch and native localized-search timings are candidate-only ordinary actions, with no invented baseline. Startup and existing field/view endpoints retain real paired controls.

languageControl.completion: app.localizer.locale, app and #studio lang/dir match target; pendingLocale null; #language-select value matches; localizer revision advanced; app.presenter.host equals #presentation-host and active presentation content is mounted inside it. Capture player queue identity, kind, index, elapsed and speed with the existing player API before/after postpause capture; preserve picker instances/raw drafts. Locale completion includes deferred selected-resource preparation, rendering, disclosure restore and semantic reading-anchor restore; wait two frames for usable selected-language content. Document lang/dir must also match when app owns data-document-owner. This clarifies the asynchronous resource transaction before measurement without changing endpoints, thresholds, samples or flag policy.

matrix.fieldProbePolicy: Core/MCP field probes remain separate from 144 primary latency cells, with their own 12 English comparisons and 84 native feature cells; never counted as primary or browser cross-product coverage.

sampling.order: Serial alternating paired arms: baseline,candidate for even zero-based sample indexes; candidate,baseline for odd indexes. Warmups retained separately and excluded from every measured statistic.
sampling.freshness: Fresh browser context per arm/cell/sample; one shared browser, fresh context storage/cache. Not cold OS caches. Strict equal request routing disables HTTP cache as in compact-mobile-browser.mjs.
sampling.latency: Host monotonic time immediately before actual navigation or UI input until declared usable result and two animation frames, including Playwright round trips. Compare sessions have no CDP, profiling, execution wrappers or resource counters.
coldMetrics: startup-saved-locale: explicit valid selected locale persisted before navigation
first-language-switch: first en-to-target activation in a fresh document
warmMetrics: repeat-language-switch: target-to-en-to-same-target in same document, each leg separately retained
sampling.startupFixture: All navigation starts at actual basic-keycloak; nondefault fixture setup and index-state setup are untimed after startup. Never report DNSSEC/JWT fixture setup as navigation startup.
sampling.failures: Retain every failed attempt and slow observation, sample identities, raw action/result metadata and input bindings. No outlier deletion, replacement by warmups or concurrent collectors.

newDefinitions.fieldOpening: First and repeated actual field disclosure opening in the same paused document, with actual close outside timing between actions. Starting closed is normalized outside timing.
newDefinitions.search: First search and repeated identical query in the same document, clearing outside timing. Native query/result IDs are frozen from production picker render in disposable untimed preflight. Native search has no invented English baseline.
newDefinitions.nativeOverhead: Saved native startup compared to matched English startup. Existing field/view actions compare matched locale arms. First/repeated locale switching and native-only search/query actions retain candidate-only classification.
newDefinitions.fieldReferences: Untimed disposable production renderer determines ordered field IDs per actual locale before timing. Canonical client_id shared query; separate native explanatory query. Only matching query/action names qualify paired controls.
newDefinitions.qualifiedHeap: Retain all same-state post-cycle readings including GC capability. Any positive final-minus-warm-reference usedSize is an open diagnostic observation, never standalone leak proof; wrapper overhead and GC qualifications retained.

operations.ready: Correct basic-keycloak, requested presentation, heldView/player/steps/scenarioPicker, visible search/title/play/current content, nonempty story/current title and nonnull held cursor; candidate locale en; two frames.
Same startup usable criterion plus app.localizer.locale equals saved tag and document direction equals locale direction; selected locale control agrees; two frames.

Actual language select input; localizer target/revision and document direction committed, selected control agrees, paused held cursor/queue/scenario unchanged, prior raw drafts retained, visible selected-fixture content; two frames.
Same criterion for each actual target-to-en and en-to-target UI action after first activation, measured individually; never silently reuse first-switch data.

Before collection freeze Unicode word and exact ordered canonical matching option IDs from active localized searchEntry data and production filterScenarioOptions. Fill #lab-scenario-search; raw query exact, actual visible option IDs equal frozen expected order, selected canonical scenario unchanged; two frames. Missing native-script prose is a fixture failure, not English substitution.

Open actual index/disclosure, fill #attribute-search with client_id; exact raw query retained and visible [data-index-attribute] IDs equal untimed frozen production-reference results; selected scenario/cursor unchanged; two frames. Also freeze native explanatory query from localized definition corpus per locale and compare its own expected canonical IDs.

Explicit global field scope, empty query, exactly 40 initial [data-index-attribute] rows; click #compact-field-more; fieldBrowser.limit 80, exactly 80 rows in frozen canonical order and focus on first appended row; two frames. Full retains unpaged field-search control and is marked not-applicable for pagination, never falsely timed as an 80-row action.

Click [data-presentation-choice=full], actual presentation full, visible #graph and #story, nonempty current content, same paused canonical queue/cursor/raw draft/query and locale/direction; two frames.

Click [data-presentation-choice=compact], actual presentation compact, visible #compact-current-title with nonempty content, same paused canonical queue/cursor/raw draft/query and locale/direction; two frames.

thresholds.targetMiss: median > 250 OR maximum > 500; retain both statistics

materialRegression.conjunction: relative increase AND absolute increase on paired-arm medians

variation.conjunction: range/median AND absolute range, evaluated separately on either arm

thresholds.largeFixturePolicy: Dense payload and long history retain separate predeclared classifications and all statistics/flags; never relabel a slow ordinary action large after measurement. No fabricated timing baseline or implicit relaxed threshold.

diagnostics.warmup: One separately retained complete paused locale/view roundtrip before stable same-surface reference snapshot.
diagnostics.cycle: For each selected non-English locale and fixture/loader/viewport: en-to-target, Compact-to-Full, target-to-en, Full-to-Compact; pause and settle at each boundary; compare same final locale/view/index/query/cursor state. Repeat equivalent cycle starting Full. Retain per-boundary and post-cycle counts, not only final totals.
metrics: loaded English bindings and active locale catalog identities/bytes
parsed catalog count and inactive locale reachability
active search index/cache entry counts and old revision reachability
live DOM nodes and detached node weak-reference counts
used JS heap bytes before/after optional supported GC
diagnostics.retentionRule: No additional parsed inactive catalogs or per-revision indexes retained after same-state return; no positive cycle-correlated listener/timer/observer/detached-node growth after warmup. Retain absolute observations, deltas and reachability evidence; unexplained growth is open. Bundled serialized catalog strings are build inputs, not evidence of parsed-catalog retention.
diagnostics.heapQualification: Heap/GC APIs are engine-dependent. Record supported/unsupported and forced/nonforced GC, repeated same-state readings, browser version and instrumentation overhead. Heap delta alone is not a leak proof or latency measurement. Unsupported metrics are explicitly unperformed, never zero. No blanket no-leak claim.
diagnostics.latencySeparation: Diagnostic session durations must not enter seven-sample latency statistics.
diagnostics.scope: Five fixtures x two matched view/viewport surfaces x three loaders x seven native locales = 210 independent diagnostic cells. Resource field probes explicitly activate global field indexes and client_id query at each boundary. No diagnostic duration enters latency.

inheritedOpenConditions.compactToFullConcern: Preserve inherited approximately 1.7-1.8 second Compact-to-Full concern independently of localization deltas and current target flags.
inheritedOpenConditions.aggregation: Different scopes, not an additive total. Fresh localization results cannot close inherited flags, human acceptance or historical qualifications.

exclusions: No browser/performance collection performed by this contract
No full suite, build or performance job during implementation
No physical-device, Safari, Firefox, assistive-technology or human acceptance inferred
No waiver, commit, push, deploy or version bump

premeasurementCorrection.reason: Representative latency axes required; the original five-fixture Cartesian product duplicated startup controls and expanded viewport/index axes unnecessarily. Corrected before any observation.
